page.overview:
Who is Giant Anteater?

It was giant anteater that was part of Condor's ninja animal team.

Due to its natural eating habit, it is a perfect counter for an insect using shinobi, catching several insects at once with his long sticky tongue.

It would use it's long tongue as a whip that was powerful enough to defeat Naruto Uzumaki's shadow clones. The anteater ate Shino Aburame's kikaichū when Shino was preparing a sneak attack on them. In the end, the anteater was defeated when Shino wrapped its tongue around a tree.
